SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

2. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   B. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

4. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

5. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

8. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.

12. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

13. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

15. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Transport in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Communicatio n in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Traditional forms of Government and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
